name: Follow up on quotes and chase unpaid invoices with Google Sheets and Gmail

parameters.content:
## Follow up on quotes and chase unpaid invoices

### How it works
For freelancers and small teams who send quotes and invoices by email and track them in one Google Sheet. Every weekday at 8:00 the workflow reads the sheet and sends the next follow-up for each open row: quotes 3, 7 and 14 days after sending, invoices 3, 10 and 21 days after the due date. It saves the stage in the sheet, so nothing is sent twice. Rows still open a week after the last email land on a call list. Rows with a bad date or email are skipped and listed.

You get a summary email on every run, also when nothing was due. If it doesn't arrive, the workflow didn't run.

### Setup
1. Create a Google Sheet with the columns type, number, client_name, client_email, amount, date, status, last_stage, last_sent_at. type is quote or invoice, status is open, amount includes the currency.
2. Fill in **Settings**: sheet URL, tab name, your email, name and payment details.
3. Connect Google Sheets (2 nodes) and Gmail (2 nodes) credentials.
4. Run it once with **dry_run = true**: every email goes to you, the sheet stays unchanged. Check the summary, then set dry_run to false and activate.

### Customization
Change the day lists in Settings. Email texts are in **Plan follow-ups**. Set a row to paid, won or lost to stop it.

## Read the sheet
All values you need to change are in **Settings**.

## Decide what is due
One email per row and run, at most. A late start sends only the highest due stage.

## Send and save the stage
A failed email is not saved and goes out again on the next run.

## Daily summary to you
Sent, failed, call list and rows to fix.

### ⚠️ dry_run
Starts as **true**: emails go to you only. Set it to false before you activate.
